calculation.description: At the completed session, reverse the overnight gap and subtract the same-session open-to-close return. This isolates a reversal spread between overnight and intraday price formation and uses no future observations. The signal predicts next close-to-close return.

validation.regime_notes: Daily ICIR remained positive across 2020-2022 (0.1639), 2023-2024 (0.1596), and 2025-2026 through 2026-09-23 (0.1357). Small cross-asset universe warrants conservative uncertainty interpretation. Library correlation requires deterministic post-Miner artifact review.

notes: Admitted on benchmark-wide daily IC and ICIR gates: absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840. Five-day evidence also clears both gates; ten-day decay does not.
